name: Cheetah
about: A side-view cheetah drawn in tapered tufts with solid spots and the tear line as its one big black shape, on a skeleton of angles that never stretches: stand, bow, crouch, skid and the rotary gallop.

can.viewNotes: side only, facing either way (flipped); her head can turn toward the camera (cheetahTurn.ts) in her own film
can.faceNotes: n/a: the rig has no faces
can.poseNotes: the rig's held poses (cheetahRig.ts), angles on bones that never stretch
